senses.definitionEn: Used with an auxiliary verb to form the negative.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: She is not coming to the party tonight.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Ella no va a venir a la fiesta esta noche.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Had we known the traffic would be so heavy, we would not have taken that route.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Si hubiéramos sabido que el tráfico iba a ser tan pesado, no habríamos tomado esa ruta.

senses.definitionEn: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard far away.

graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Aquello que no nos mata nos hace más fuertes.

senses.definitionEn: Used to introduce a subordinate clause expressing a statement or reason.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I think that we should leave now.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: It is essential that all employees attend the annual safety briefing.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Es fundamental que todos los empleados asistan a la sesión informativa anual de seguridad.

senses.contextualHint: primera persona del plural como sujeto
senses.definitionEn: Used by the speaker to refer to themselves and one or more other people as the subject of a verb.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: We are going to the supermarket.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: We find ourselves facing unprecedented economic challenges.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Nos encontramos enfrentando desafíos económicos sin precedentes.

senses.definitionEn: Physically in contact with and supported by a surface.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: Your keys are on the kitchen table.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Tus llaves están sobre la mesa de la cocina.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: The historic agreement was signed on the condition that both parties compromise.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: El acuerdo histórico se firmó con la condición de que ambas partes lleguen a un compromiso.

senses.definitionEn: Accompanied by; possessing or using something.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I like to drink coffee with milk.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Me gusta tomar café con leche.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: She approached the delicate negotiation with remarkable poise and confidence.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Abordó la delicada negociación con notable aplomo y confianza.

senses.contextualHint: referirse a algo cercano o actual
senses.definitionEn: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand or being experienced.

graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: This demonstrates the urgent need for a comprehensive policy overhaul.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Esto demuestra la necesidad urgente de una revisión integral de la política.
